title: stelis parahybunensis
intro: Stelis parahybunensis, commonly known as the Brazilian orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stelis parahybunensis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which make it useful for wound healing and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
